modules.title: The Inner Compass
modules.description: Define your version of fulfillment and create your life mission.

submodules.title: 📝 Introduction
submodules.body:
Before I build anything lasting, I need a compass — something internal that points me toward meaning, happiness, and the things that excite me to get out of bed in the morning. This isn't about finding my ultimate purpose right now. It's about pointing myself toward the things that matter most to me.

This module will help me define what fulfillment actually means to me, reconnect with what lights me up, and write a mission statement that feels authentic and true to myself — whether I whisper it quietly or wear it boldly. Clarity doesn't arrive all at once; it's created by asking the right questions and allowing answers to emerge one by one.

submodules.title: 🔍 Define Fulfillment, My Way
prompts: What is something I've done that completely lights me up?
How do I feel when I do it?
Where in my body do I feel that energy or sense of rightness?

submodules.title: 🌀 Assess My Season of Life
prompts: What is this season asking of me right now?
Do I want to stay in this season for a while, or am I ready to move through it?
What are a few things I can do (or stop doing) to honor that decision?

submodules.title: 💎 Name My Core Values
prompts: Which values feel most alive for me right now?
Which ones do I crave more of?
If I had to live out one value this week — which one would it be, and why?

submodules.title: ✍️ Draft My Mission Statement
submodules.starter: I help / support / create / offer [who] [what] so they can [desired outcome].
examples: I help women rediscover confidence after burnout through mindful routines.
I create moments that help couples reconnect and feel alive again.
I support people in living simpler, more meaningful lives through intentional travel and self-connection.
prompts: What do I feel most proud to give, create, or share with the world?
What have others always come to me for?
Who do I feel most called to serve — or create for?

submodules.title: 🌅 Feel into Direction (Not Just Goals)
prompts: Where am I living?
What am I doing in the mornings?
How do I feel in my body and in my work?
What have I let go of?
What have I added more of?

submodules.title: 💭 Mindful Moment
submodules.prompt: When I imagine my ideal day, what is the feeling I most want to experience — and how can I bring 5% more of that into tomorrow?

submodules.title: 📝 Introduction
submodules.body:
Before I can build what I want, I need to understand where I actually am.

This module is about getting honest with myself — without shame, without sugarcoating. Just clarity. I’m taking a snapshot of the life I’m currently living so I can gently sort through what’s working, what’s not, and what needs attention next.

This isn’t about fixing everything at once. It’s about seeing clearly, naming the friction points, and starting to design from a place of self-awareness instead of self-avoidance.

This is where real change begins.

submodules.title: 🔍 Take a Clarity Snapshot
submodules.prompt: Which 2–3 areas feel like they need the most attention right now — and why?

submodules.title: 🔥 Identify My Friction Points
prompts: What am I tolerating that I know isn’t healthy for me?
Where am I shrinking, hesitating, or holding back my voice?
What are the recurring frustrations or patterns that I keep brushing aside?

submodules.title: 🌱 Fuel Check: What’s Supporting Me?
prompts: What feels genuinely good right now?
Where do I feel most proud of how I’ve been showing up?
Who or what is energizing me — and how can I nurture that?

submodules.title: 🔄 The Crossroads: What Needs to Shift?
prompts: What choices do I need to make right now to move in a healthier direction?
What’s one friction point I can start resolving this month — with grace, not pressure?
If I were giving honest advice to a friend in my shoes, what would I say?

submodules.title: 💭 Mindful Moment
submodules.prompt: Where in my life am I choosing comfort over alignment — and what would a brave next step look like?
